summary: Rotation day: money is moving out of AI and chip names into bonds and value, with the Dow up, the Nasdaq down, and oil rallying.
market_note: Dow higher, Nasdaq lower; tech selloff deepening on AI financing worries.

items.why: Chip rout continuing: CoreWeave bond selloff revived worries about AI infrastructure financing, and Anthropic revenue slowdown news hit the sector, per Barron's and Barchart.
Crude rallying as hot September PPI and CPI data (energy and gasoline up sharply) revived inflation and energy price pressure.
Sliding ahead of tonight's Roadster unveiling event as hot inflation data and high Treasury yields weigh on high-multiple growth stocks.
Ten-year yield dropping as investors rotate into bonds amid the AI-led tech selloff and rotation out of chips.
